name: Ivory Breeze
source:
A story about a group of pirates who sought for refuge in the city of Greisenberg after a mysterious force left their ship in ruins.  Trying to find a way out, Kane,  a pirate from the ship tries to explore a bit to find any way to get the ship back in working order, but instead... he finds something that should've been left unseen.

[From [url=https://jagshiro.itch.io/ivory-breeze]Itch.io[/url]]
